senses.gloss: €10U. (चिह्नयति-ते) To mark, stamp (properly a Denom. from the noun चिह्न).

__1 Mark, spot, stamp, symbol; emblem, badge, symptom; ग्रामेषु यूपचिह्नेषु [[R. 1. 44]]; 3. 55; संनिपातस्य चिह्नानि [[Pt. 1. 177.]] 
__2 A sign, indication; प्रसादचिह्नानि पुरःफलानि [[R. 2. 22]]; प्रहर्षचिह्न 2. 68. 
__3 A sign of the zodiac. 
__4 Stamp, print, impression; पद°. 
__5 Aim, direction. 
-Comp. 
-कारिन् a. 
__1 marking, spotting. 
__2 striking, wounding, killing. 
__3 frightful, hideous.

a. 
__1 Marked, signed, stamped, bearing the badges of an office; [[Y. 2. 85]]; 1. 319; दिबा चरेयुः कार्यार्थं चिह्निता राजशासनैः [[Ms. 10. 55]]; 2. 170. 
__2 Branded. 
__3 Known, designated.
